reason: The claimed identification of smooth structures misuses the uniqueness clause of lem-topology-quotient-manifold. That theorem gives uniqueness only among smooth structures on calU_e/U(1) for which p is a smooth submersion, but the allowed contract of lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package merely says breve-calU is a connected compact orientable smooth manifold and does not assert that its quotient projection p is smooth, let alone a submersion. Hence no allowed input shows that the package's smooth structure equals the quotient-theorem structure; without this compatibility, the local smooth-section formulas establish smoothness of breve-mu and breve-sigma only for the newly supplied quotient structure, not for the pre-existing package structure invoked in node 1.1. The node must either strengthen the dependency with p-submersion compatibility or explicitly choose the quotient-theorem structure and justify transfer of all package conclusions to it.
